commands:
docker exec -i django_backend python manage.py shell << 'EOF'
from apps.quiz.models import Subject
try:
    s = Subject.objects.get(name='MATHEMATICS')
    s.delete()
    print('Deleted MATHEMATICS.')
except Subject.DoesNotExist:
    pass

subject, created = Subject.objects.get_or_create(name='Mathematics', defaults={'slug': 'mathematics'})
if created:
    print('Subject Mathematics created successfully.')
else:
    print('Subject Mathematics already exists.')
EOF
